import ctypes
import sys

# Load the GSL libraries in correct order
cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl_lib = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Set up the function prototypes
gsl_lib.gsl_hypot.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl_lib.gsl_hypot.restype = ctypes.c_double

gsl_lib.gsl_hypot3.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl_lib.gsl_hypot3.restype = ctypes.c_double

def gsl_hypot_py(x, y, z=None):
    if z is None:
        return gsl_lib.gsl_hypot(x, y)
    else:
        return gsl_lib.gsl_hypot3(x, y, z)

def assert_test():
    # Test two arguments
    assert abs(gsl_hypot_py(3.0, 4.0) - 5.0) < 1e-10
    assert abs(gsl_hypot_py(0.0, 5.0) - 5.0) < 1e-10
    assert abs(gsl_hypot_py(-3.0, -4.0) - 5.0) < 1e-10
    assert gsl_hypot_py(0.0, 0.0) == 0.0
    
    # Test three arguments
    assert abs(gsl_hypot_py(2.0, 3.0, 6.0) - 7.0) < 1e-10
    assert abs(gsl_hypot_py(1.0, 2.0, 2.0) - 3.0) < 1e-10
    assert abs(gsl_hypot_py(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) - 0.0) < 1e-10
    assert abs(gsl_hypot_py(-1.0, -2.0, -2.0) - 3.0) < 1e-10
    
    # Test large values
    large_val = 1e100
    assert abs(gsl_hypot_py(large_val, large_val) - (large_val * (2**0.5))) < 1e90
    assert abs(gsl_hypot_py(large_val, large_val, large_val) - (large_val * (3**0.5))) < 1e90
    
    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
